instructions: Trust root for vendor-signed aidr-license-v1 on-prem and air-gapped licenses (scripts/license-verify.mjs).
This shipped file is intentionally empty: with no keys every license is refused (fail closed).

Replace it only with the registry published by Singularity R&D for your release, delivered with the signed customer kit, and compare its SHA-256 with the value in the release notes before installing it.
Each key entry: { key_id, algorithm: "ed25519", public_key_pem, not_before, not_after (null while in use), status: active | retired | revoked }.

Rotation: a new key is added as active; the previous key becomes retired and still verifies licenses issued inside its not_before..not_after window; a compromised key becomes revoked and verifies nothing.
Never place a private key in this file. Development test keys exist only inside test fixtures and must never be added here.
